content: Joined the Multimedia Signal and Intelligent Information Processing (MSIIP) Lab in the Department of Electronic Engineering at Tsinghua University as an M.S. student, advised by Prof. Ji Wu.
Attended the Agentic AI Summit 2026 at UC Berkeley.
Earned my M.S.E. in Biomedical Engineering from Johns Hopkins University through the THU-JHU Dual Degree Program.
Served as the undergraduate representative and led the graduation oath at Xi'an Jiaotong University's 2025 Commencement Ceremony.
SurvUnc: A Meta-Model Based Uncertainty Quantification Framework for Survival Analysis was accepted to the Research Track at KDD 2025.
